build.locales: FormatJS default Chromium subset; magrinj shipping compiled data
build.magrinjBootstrap: Precompiled Hermes -O bytecode, from pinned source
build.overlap: Identical precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: __now when available, otherwise Date.now; 50 ms calibration, seven timing rounds per case
order: Three complete overlap runs alternate before/after/magrinj and reverse order. No builds run during timings. Five older focused native runs alternate forward/reverse host order; their legacy comparator measurements are separated.

profiles.method: Hermes Chrome sampling profiler at 1000 Hz. Host samples aggregate C++ and Rust.

legacyRuntimeSourceMeasurements.note: Comparator bootstrap and workload were evaluated as runtime source, without the full optimization pipeline. These are historical measurements, not the optimized comparison.

legacyControlNote: Single diagnostic run on the patched comparator host with identical optimized workload and runtime-source bootstrap.
